executiveSummary: OT-facing risk is elevated to Critical due to multiple, concurrently exploited edge and control-system pathways: active compromises of water-sector PLCs; nation-state router exploitation at scale; perimeter device KEV additions; and high-severity ICS advisories with operational impact and, in some cases, no available vendor fix. Water/Wastewater operators in the U.S. face ongoing activity directly targeting internet-exposed PLCs, resulting in lockouts and operational disruptions; immediate removal of direct internet access and hardened remote access is required Security Advisory . A multi-agency U.S. advisory details Iranian-affiliated actors actively exploiting PLCs across critical sectors, modifying logic and disabling alarms; remove direct access, validate logic integrity, and enforce segmented, monitored remote access Supporting Report . Russia’s FSB Center 16 is exploiting poorly configured routers (SNMP, SMI) across critical sectors to stage access and steal configs; shift to SNMPv3, disable SMI, restrict TFTP/FTP, and harden edge management Security Advisory . Mitsubishi Electric CC‑Link IE TSN integrity weakness enables on-segment I/O tampering; no code fix planned—enforce strict network isolation and port security immediately Vendor Advisory . Toptech RCU II+ / Multiload II+ terminal controllers expose an unauthenticated debug service granting root access; apply vendor VRT, patch, and segment devices from untrusted networks Security Advisory . Active exploitation waves continue against perimeters: F5 BIG‑IP APM RCE, Cisco FMC hard-coded password KEV, Fortinet, Check Point VPN auth-bypass, and N‑able N‑central RMM; patch, isolate management planes, and hunt for persistence CERT-FR Alert CISA KEV . Supply-chain and AI-enabled threat activity is rising (Zimbra 0‑day “Ulej/Flowerbed,” AI-assisted intrusion testing escapes, new APT backdoors and tunneling); implement strict egress controls, identity hardening, and software supply-chain safeguards Security Advisory Vendor Disclosure . Priority focus: remove direct OT exposure, remediate KEV-listed perimeters, harden router/remote access hygiene, and validate ICS logic/config integrity this week.

Valid Accounts (T1078) via VPN/RMM takeover; Session hijack/app-password persistence on webmail.
Router/SNMP/SMI abuse for config theft; TFTP/FTP exfil and Smart Install misuse on Cisco edges.
DNS/HTTPS C2 and WSS tunneling; DNS AAAA config recovery (OilRig CAV3RN) and long-subdomain exfil patterns.
Credential Access: Kerberoasting (enterprise AD), LSASS access; Key-material exfil from servers.
ICS ATT&CK: Modify Program (T0831), Impair Process Control (T0829), Loss of View (T0827), Modify Alarm Settings (T0822).
